summary.zh: 维护项目上下文文档并保持与代码一致
summary.en: Keep product, stack and workflow context docs in sync

description.zh: 为新项目生成产品说明、技术栈、开发流程和工作单元四类上下文文档，也能从现有代码库提炼这些内容，并在实现前检查文档是否一致。适合项目启动、接手旧项目或文档逐渐失真时使用。
description.en: Scaffolds product, tech stack, workflow and work-unit docs in a conductor directory or extracts them from an existing codebase, and checks consistency before implementation. Good for new projects or hand-overs.
